annotations.title: Live: how the app is doing

description: Reads the Live app in one call: people who joined and were active this calendar month against last month, refund-aware revenue this month against last (per currency, minor units), subscribers by plan, errors in the last 24 hours and their codes, what waits on the founder (approvals asked in their browser, unanswered Inbox conversations, refusals on the Errors page), and whether Live is paused. The first read for "how is the app doing?"; live_errors, live_usage, live_webhooks, live_emails and live_inbox go deeper. live:read; audited; changes nothing.
